sources.title: Systems engineering handbook: interfaces and verification
sources.finding: Integration and verification planning connect requirements, interfaces and evidence.

sources.title: IEC 62278-1:2025
sources.finding: Railway RAMS lifecycle management scope.
sources.limitation: Public scope only; project safety allocation and the applicable complete standard series require controlled review.

sources.title: IEC 62290-1:2025
sources.finding: Urban guided transport management and command/control concepts.
sources.limitation: No GoA4 certification, protocol specification or safety integrity level inferred from the public scope.

sources.title: IEC 62928:2017
sources.finding: Onboard lithium-ion traction battery design and test scope.
sources.limitation: Stationary storage and charging installations need their own applicable standards; no cell-to-pack approval inferred.

sources.title: IEC 61373:2010
sources.finding: Railway equipment shock and vibration test scope.
sources.limitation: Mounting category, test levels and clauses require project review; a CAD attachment is not qualification.

sources.title: IEC 62497-1:2010 with AMD1:2013 review required
sources.finding: Rail insulation coordination includes rolling stock, signalling and fixed installations.
sources.limitation: Adopted edition/amendment, altitude, pollution, voltage and clearances require controlled clause review.

sources.title: IEC 62236-3-2:2018
sources.finding: Rolling-stock apparatus electromagnetic compatibility scope.
sources.limitation: Apparatus evidence does not qualify the complete vehicle or wayside system; select other series parts as applicable.

sources.title: ISO 55001:2024
sources.finding: Asset-management requirements address lifecycle decisions.
sources.limitation: A management-system reference, not a component maintenance interval or asset certification.

sources.title: ISO 21542:2021
sources.finding: Accessibility and usability of buildings and their approaches.
sources.limitation: Vehicle and platform boarding limits and national accessibility rules require separate adoption.

sources.title: ISO 19659-2:2020
sources.finding: Passenger-area thermal comfort and measurement scope.
sources.limitation: Does not cover driver-cab thermal comfort; climate, loads and acceptance values need project selection.

sources.title: ISO 19659-4:2026
sources.finding: HVAC customer design inputs and unit test/inspection scope.
sources.limitation: Public scope reviewed; unit test evidence must be integrated with saloon/cab and installed duct performance.

sources.title: ISO 3381:2021
sources.finding: Reproducible vehicle interior noise type-test methods.
sources.limitation: No universal noise limit or whole-journey exposure result inferred.

sources.title: ISO 12944-2:2017
sources.finding: Steel protective-coating exposure classification.
sources.limitation: Classification alone does not select a coating; preparation, application, durability and inspection require additional applicable methods.

sources.title: ISO 14040:2006
sources.finding: Lifecycle assessment goal, scope and interpretation framework.
sources.limitation: Review amendment and other applicable LCA/EPD methods; no carbon saving transferred from a vendor statement.

sources.title: BS EN 45545-2:2020+A1:2023
sources.finding: Rail vehicle material/component fire-behaviour scope.
sources.limitation: Hazard/category, requirement set and actual installed build-up require controlled review; no blanket fire rating.

sources.title: SP 800-82 Rev. 3: operational technology security
sources.finding: OT security must account for physical processes, availability and safety.
sources.limitation: Reference guidance; railway threat model and applicable IEC/rail-specific cyber requirements remain project decisions.

sources.title: LOC&PAS TSI and current application guidance
sources.finding: Vehicle/subsystem interfaces and links to current guidance and amendments.
sources.limitation: EU interoperability applicability must be decided for each project; metro/tram scope is not assumed. No global legal adoption.

sources.title: Entities in charge of maintenance
sources.finding: Maintenance functions require responsibility and traceability in the ECM system.
sources.limitation: EU certification applicability is project-dependent; guidance version 10.0 (2025) listed at review.

sources.title: Public Transportation Agency Safety Plans
sources.finding: Agency safety plans incorporate safety-management processes.
sources.limitation: US funding/oversight applicability is limited; OSR adapts the management approach, not a global legal requirement.

sources.title: Report 0215: track inspection and maintenance
sources.finding: Review of US rail-transit inspection and maintenance practice.
sources.limitation: 2022 research portal reviewed; local defect limits, intervals and current rules require independent selection.

sources.title: Emergency preparedness planning guide (2003)
sources.finding: Emergency response planning is a system lifecycle activity.
sources.limitation: Historical planning reference; current fire, evacuation and emergency-response requirements must govern each project.

sources.title: Bridge concrete technical resources
sources.finding: Public precast/prestressed bridge construction and assessment resources.
sources.limitation: Road bridge methods need railway load, fatigue, vibration and jurisdiction transfer review; no curing duration adopted from the portal.

sources.title: Bridge preservation resources
sources.finding: Preservation and service-life planning include assessment and maintenance.
sources.limitation: Road bridge reference; actual railway inspection criteria and access plans remain project-specific.

sources.title: Evolution of railway axlebox technology
sources.finding: Axlebox bearing architecture includes sealing, lubrication and integration.
sources.limitation: Supplier architecture reference; fits, loads, lubricants, life and intervals require released supplier data.

sources.title: Railway secondary suspension
sources.finding: Air-spring solutions couple vehicle support and ride behaviour.
sources.limitation: No universal stiffness, emergency capacity or maintenance interval inferred.

sources.title: Adhesion and wheel-slide protection
sources.finding: Adhesion management and wheel-slide protection belong to integrated braking systems.
sources.limitation: No stopping-distance improvement or proprietary control algorithm adopted; qualify actual duty and degraded modes.

sources.title: Train entrance systems
sources.finding: Entrance equipment is supplied as integrated door systems.
sources.limitation: No closing force, speed, geometry or interoperability acceptance imported from marketing.

sources.title: Rail bonding and coating applications
sources.finding: Rail bonding requires application-specific design, production and material data; EN 17460 is identified.
sources.limitation: Supplier method context, not independent proof of product superiority or bonding certification; review EN 17460 separately.

sources.title: Fastclip rail fastening system
sources.finding: Elastic fastening is a rail/pad/insulator/clip installation system.
sources.limitation: Specific vendor system is a candidate only; no generic clip force, spacing or approved interchangeability.

sources.title: Turnout systems and lifecycle integration
sources.finding: Turnout geometry, actuation, signalling and lifecycle care are treated as one system.
sources.limitation: Vendor lifecycle approach; no actuator load or inspection interval adopted.

sources.title: HMAX for signalling
sources.finding: Asset monitoring supports maintenance decisions for signalling.
sources.limitation: Advisory monitoring is not safety authority; no predictive accuracy, interval extension or vendor platform dependency adopted.

sources.title: IFC railway domain and open exchange
sources.finding: IFC 4.3 provides railway spatial structures for open information exchange.
sources.limitation: Export must be checked for units, identity and semantics; an IFC file is not a construction release.

sources.title: IEC 62279:2015
sources.finding: Railway control/protection software development process scope.
sources.limitation: Full clauses, tool qualification and applicable edition transitions require project review. Source SIL/GoA target labels do not establish achieved integrity.
